scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @fnab/server" "npm run dev -w @fnab/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fnab/client && npm run build -w @fnab/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fnab/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fnab/server && npm run typecheck -w @fnab/client
